$comment: Internal model extraction proposal only. The public intent endpoint grounds field names against admitted output schemas and returns schema_version 2; see ask-intent-fields.md. Proposed field names are not source coverage evidence.

language.description: Language of the original input: ISO 639-1, or und for indeterminate symbols.

subjects.description: Every named entity or concrete topic in the input. Copy labels exactly; never translate or correct spelling. Use an empty array only when no concrete subject exists.

label.description: Exact contiguous substring of the user input, preserving spelling, case and punctuation.

capabilities.description: Only NEW definitions absent from the supplied catalog. Reuse existing slugs without redefining them here.

subject_ids.description: IDs of the subjects for THIS request. Different fields or filters require separate requests with their own subject bindings.

kind.description: lookup/search for external information; action for a requested external operation; answer for conversation, writing, poetry or calculations.

goal.description: Meaning of this request in English, with no added topics or requirements.

required_fields.description: Only explicitly required data fields, including requested source/profile links. Never place an available/if available field here.

optional_fields.description: Fields qualified by available/if available. If a qualifier introduces a list, ALL fields in that list belong here, not in required_fields.

sources.description: Explicitly requested provider names, each copied exactly from input. Do not select or invent providers.

format.description: chat unless the user explicitly requests another output format.

operations.description: Requested comparisons, rankings, explanations or transformations, expressed in English. These are not extra retrieval requests.

literalMap.description: Only explicit key/value criteria or identifiers. Every value is an exact substring of input, with no translated dates, invented URLs, normalization or inferred values. Use {} when absent.
